sample_unit: LLM responses (40 questions x 3 models), rated by 3 reviewers (360 assessments)

links.outcome: Unsafe-content and hallucination events in LLM responses to parent ITP questions
links.effect: Two response-level unsafe-content/hallucination events, both in Gemini 3 Flash responses (2/40, 5.0%; exact 95% CI, 0.6%-16.9%); involved overgeneralized autoimmune-testing advice and unsupported MMR vaccination counseling.
links.quote: Two response-level unsafe-content and hallucination events were detected, both in Gemini 3 Flash responses (2/40, 5.0%; exact 95% CI, 0.6%-16.9%).

screen.reason: Expert evaluation of 3 freely accessible LLMs responding to standardized pediatric ITP health questions for parents, assessing accuracy, safety, and readability.
